title: PRESSER | Patton Pinkins - Maui Preview (11-19-26)
text: You know, Tuesday Tuesday night in the game, you're perfect from the field. You started off the season over 70 percent from three. You know, what about this team has allowed you to get off to such a hot start so far this season? >> Yeah, probably have to be our playmakers. Um, Bud Clark, um, Ben Hinson, and Elias Cameroun. And just, you know, being unselfish, getting me open. Um, so that's why, you know, I've gotten off to a hot start. They make the right plays and they're unselfish. >> How are you looking to carry on your hot start into the Maui Invitational? You know, playing better competition. >> Yeah. >> The team's going to need some great production from you this year. How are you looking to carry on? >> Yeah, like you said, better competition for sure. Um, so it'll be a challenge, but you know, um, just playing the right way like I've been, you know, taking shots when I'm open, playing hard um, on both ends. That will definitely help translate to this better competition in Maui. >> Aside from the scoreboard, what do you want to get out of this tournament? Is there anything you can draw off from Puerto Rico? >> What was it again, the last part? >> Is there anything you can draw off from Puerto Rico for this tournament going forward? >> Yeah, probably just more chemistry stuff. Like Hawaii is a beautiful place, so just doing stuff with teammates um, off the court, you know, help chemistry going into finishing up non-conference play and SEC play. So that's something I'm looking, you know, to do. >> What's the scout on Clemson heading into the tournament? >> Yeah, um, kind of like Central Arkansas. Um, fundamental team, can shoot threes. Um, guys play the right way. Um, so kind of pressure them, trying to make them turn the ball over is is the scout on it. >> It's still a pretty new team, I mean, but if you guys are first in the nation scoring defense, first in the nation turnover margin, what can you say about this this team's communication even though you're all so new to each other? >> Right. Yeah, it's great. Um, you know, every day in practice um, we kind we kind of focus on that. We have drills or, you know, Coach Beard wants us to talk and that's helped us on the court cuz, you know, you got to talk defensively. So that's helped us. >> What is this a successful what is this successful trip in Maui you look for Ole Miss team? >> Shoot, three and 0 and bringing back, you know, some hardware to Oxford. That's that's that's, you know, what we're trying to do. >> All right, thank you, guys. >> Yep.
